A vast network of caverns winds through the mountain's heart, holding legendary treasures and secrets from Azeroth's distant past.|''[[The Art of World of Warcraft: Legion]]'', pg. 75}} '''Highmountain''' is a [[zone|region]] that dominates the northern horizon of the [[Broken Isles]] with its jagged peaks. It is one of the last great frontiers of the isles,Scouting Map named in honor of [[Huln Highmountain]] for his bravery in the [[War of the Ancients]].[[Huln's War - The Nathrezim]] ==History== Over 10,000 years ago, the [[Dragon Aspect]] [[Neltharion]] had a [[Neltharion's Lair|lair]] and [[Neltharion's Vault|vault]] in the mountains here. It was here where he kept the [[:Hammer of Khaz'goroth]] and where he created the [[Demon Soul|Dragon Soul]]. When the [[War of the Ancients]] broke out, the [[tauren]] hero [[Huln Highmountain]] united the disparate tauren tribes of the area and led them into battle alongside the [[Kaldorei Resistance]]. After the war ended, the region was named Highmountain in Huln's honor. Long ago, the [[Old Gods]] sought to claim Highmountain. Their campaign was led by [[Uul'gyneth]]. Huln Highmountain gathered heroes from among the tribes, and fought against Uul'gyneth's servants, the [[Necrodark]]. Yet the forces of shadow were too great to overcome. So Huln devised another plan. Wards were placed to lock away the Old Gods' influence. Though the general survived, Uul'gyneth's essence was trapped. ===Legion=== {{legion-section}} Following the [[war in Draenor]], the [[Burning Legion]] began to invade Azeroth through the [[Tomb of Sargeras]]. The [[Highmountain tauren|tauren]] of Highmountain, descended from Huln Highmountain and other tauren who had fought in the War of the Ancients,{{Dead link|https://www.youtube.com/watch?v{{=}}iCPPCssbt-o Blizzcon 2015: World and Content Overview Panel}} had been living in peace with the local [[drogbar]] for generations, but when the Legion invaded, the drogbar stole the tauren's sacred artifact, the Hammer of Khaz'goroth. The Highmountain are now at risk of being taken over by the drogbar and their king [[Dargrul the Underking]], ruling his kin from the [[Neltharion's Lair|former lair]] of the [[Black dragonflight|black]] [[Dragon Aspects|aspect]] [[Neltharion]]. As is his habit when new parts of the world are ready to be discovered, the one and only [[Hemet Nesingwary]] makes his way to the mountains of the Broken Isles in search of new and exotic dangerous animals to hunt. The wards bounding Uul'gyneth began to weaken just enough for the Darkness to seep through, and the Necrodark began to summon Uul'gyneth into the physical realm.[[Curse of the Necrodark]] Though Uul'gyneth did manage to incarnate itself, it was defeated by a [[Horde]] [[adventurer]].[[The Darkness (quest)]] At one point, an [[eredar]] named [[Despoiler Egrothar]] desecrated the sacred burial sites of the Highmountain tribe, raising the bodies of the dead. The [[Knights of the Silver Hand|Order of the Silver Hand]] sent their troops to kill the demon and put them back to rest.[[Blood of Our Enemy: Highmountain]] They also made contact with a [[tribe]] of [[Highmountain tauren]], who had an excess supply of furs and leather, after they took down a [[demon]] incursion led by a [[doomguard]] named [[Raidmaster Sorthol]] who stood in their way.[[The Highlord's Command: Procuring Supplies]] ==Geography== The namesake mountain of this region, [[Highmountain Peak]], is among the tallest mountains in all of [[Azeroth]], and the Highmountain range which surrounds it is filled with untamed wilds, deep canyons, fertile valleys, and icy peaks. Because the waters of Highmountain flow into [[Suramar]], [[Stormheim]], and [[Val'sharah]], the area serves as the lifeblood of virtually every region on the [[Broken Isles]]. Below the surface of the region lies an infinite network of tunnels and caverns, with steam and warmth implying potential volcanic activity.{{Ref
